## Review checklist

- [ ] I followed the repository's local instructions and existing release gates.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, customer data, or confidential attachments.
- [ ] Evidence supports the stated result; unknowns and failed checks are identified.
- [ ] Required independent review is complete, or this PR remains pending that review.
- [ ] Documentation and operational records reflect the changed behavior where needed.
